I've replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was Southgate.

That comes from Priyanka's notes in that channel on 3 Sep 2025. She wrote that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. Her resolution note at 18:43 says Southgate cleared the backlog.

The channel doesn't have an address or any other site details, and the shared files have no Tansley account folder. I told him Priyanka is the person to ask for more. I only used the incident channel, which he's a member of.
